steps.caption: Open Deal toolkit from the sidebar.
Four stages: write the brief, run the numbers, check and approve, make the client document.
'What exactly do you need?' — the requirement brief.
'What will this lease really cost?' — lease economics, and cost per seat all-in.
'Should we stay or move?' and 'Lease or managed office?' — side-by-side comparisons.
Landlord offers, negotiation rounds and fit-out quotes each have their own tool.
Built-to-suit and investment returns sit under Specialist models.
Each card has one clear button; the counter shows how many you have saved with that tool.
Fit-out & loan: budget the fit-out, then Financing works out the loan.
Make a client document and Site-visit pack turn saved work into Word, PDF and decks.
Every number comes from fixed, tested formulas — not from AI — and keeps its inputs.
Needs information lists saved work with missing inputs — blanks are never treated as zero.
Requirements awaiting analysis: client searches with nothing worked out yet.
Recently updated: your latest saved analyses with version and status — click one to open it.
A red box warns when a landlord quote has expired or expires within 14 days.
Start with a brief is the suggested first step for any new client search.
